WITH
-- 1. Identify PE admissions in elderly female patients
pe_admissions AS (
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.hospital_expire_flag,
    DATETIME_DIFF(a.dischtime, a.admittime, SECOND)/86400.0 AS los_days
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
      ON a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses` dd
      ON d.icd_code = dd.icd_code
     AND d.icd_version = dd.icd_version
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 74 AND 84
    AND LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%pulmonary embol%'
  GROUP BY
    a.subject_id, a.hadm_id, a.admittime, a.dischtime, a.hospital_expire_flag
),

-- 2. Medication complexity: count of distinct prescriptions in first 24h
meds_first24 AS (
  SELECT
    hadm_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(drug, '/', dose_unit_rx, '/', route)) AS med_complexity
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions` rx
    JOIN pe_admissions pa
      ON rx.hadm_id = pa.hadm_id
  WHERE
    rx.starttime BETWEEN pa.admittime
      AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(pa.admittime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
  GROUP BY
    hadm_id
),

-- 3a. QT-prolonging drug list (example subset)
qt_drugs AS (
  SELECT 'Amiodarone' AS drug UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Sotalol' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Dofetilide' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Quinidine'
),

-- 3b. Bleeding-risk drug list (example subset)
bleed_drugs AS (
  SELECT 'Heparin' AS drug UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Enoxaparin' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Warfarin' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Apixaban' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Rivaroxaban'
),

-- 3c. Flag presence of QT and bleeding drugs in first 24h
drug_flags AS (
  SELECT
    pa.hadm_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(rx.drug) IN (SELECT LOWER(drug) FROM qt_drugs) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_qt_drug,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(rx.drug) IN (SELECT LOWER(drug) FROM bleed_drugs) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_bleed_drug
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions` rx
    JOIN pe_admissions pa
      ON rx.hadm_id = pa.hadm_id
  WHERE
    rx.starttime BETWEEN pa.admittime
      AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(pa.admittime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
  GROUP BY
    pa.hadm_id
),

-- 4. ICU admission flag
icu_flag AS (
  SELECT
    hadm_id,
    1 AS icu_admitted
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays`
  GROUP BY hadm_id
),

-- 5. Combine metrics
cohort_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    pa.hadm_id,
    pa.los_days,
    pa.hospital_expire_flag,
    COALESCE(m.med_complexity, 0) AS med_complexity,
    COALESCE(d.has_qt_drug, 0) AS has_qt_drug,
    COALESCE(d.has_bleed_drug, 0) AS has_bleed_drug,
    IFNULL(icu.icu_admitted, 0) AS icu_flag
  FROM
    pe_admissions pa
    LEFT JOIN meds_first24 m USING (hadm_id)
    LEFT JOIN drug_flags d USING (hadm_id)
    LEFT JOIN icu_flag icu USING (hadm_id)
)

-- Final aggregation
SELECT
  -- Overall complexity distribution
  AVG(med_complexity)                     AS complexity_mean,
  MIN(med_complexity)                     AS complexity_min,
  MAX(med_complexity)                     AS complexity_max,
  STDDEV_POP(med_complexity)              AS complexity_sd,

  -- Prevalence of QT‐prolonging and bleeding‐risk drugs
  100.0 * SUM(has_qt_drug) / COUNT(*)       AS pct_with_qt_drug,
  100.0 * SUM(has_bleed_drug) / COUNT(*)    AS pct_with_bleed_drug,

  -- Complexity percentiles (approximate)
  (SELECT quantiles[SAFE_OFFSET(1)] FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(med_complexity, 4)) AS quantiles) AS p25_complexity,
  (SELECT quantiles[SAFE_OFFSET(2)] FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(med_complexity, 4)) AS quantiles) AS p50_complexity,
  (SELECT quantiles[SAFE_OFFSET(3)] FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(med_complexity, 4)) AS quantiles) AS p75_complexity,

  -- ICU vs non‐ICU comparison
  AVG(IF(icu_flag=1, med_complexity, NULL))         AS icu_complexity_mean,
  AVG(IF(icu_flag=0, med_complexity, NULL))         AS nonicu_complexity_mean,
  100.0 * SUM(IF(icu_flag=1 AND has_qt_drug=1,1,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(IF(icu_flag=1,1,0)),0)  AS icu_pct_qt,
  100.0 * SUM(IF(icu_flag=0 AND has_qt_drug=1,1,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(IF(icu_flag=0,1,0)),0)  AS nonicu_pct_qt,

  -- Top‐quartile LOS and mortality among top‐quartile stays
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(los_days >= (
          SELECT quantiles[SAFE_OFFSET(3)]
          FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(los_days,4)) AS quantiles
        ) AND hospital_expire_flag=1,1,0)),
    SUM(IF(los_days >= (
          SELECT quantiles[SAFE_OFFSET(3)]
          FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(los_days,4)) AS quantiles
        ),1,0))
  ) * 100.0 AS top_quartile_mortality_pct

FROM cohort_metrics;
